title: QA Engineer
description:
Job Description
**About the Role**
==================


We are looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented Software Engineer in Quality Assurance (Automation) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of building and scaling our test automation ecosystem — owning quality end\-to\-end, from test design to continuous delivery pipelines. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure our products are robust, reliable, and release\-ready at all times.

  

**What You'll Do**
==================


* **Design, build \& maintain** scalable automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, and TestNG.


* **Own test strategy** for assigned squads — defining scope, coverage, and risk from requirements through production.


* **Write BDD feature files** (Gherkin) to enable collaboration between QA, Dev, and Product stakeholders.


* **Implement TDD practices** — writing tests before or alongside code to drive quality in development cycles.


* **Integrate automated suites** into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar) for continuous feedback.


* **Perform API testing** and validate end\-to\-end user journeys across web and services.


* **Identify, document \& triage defects** with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and root\-cause analysis.


* **Mentor junior QA engineers** and champion quality best practices across the engineering org.


* **Continuously evaluate** test health, flakiness, and coverage gaps — iterating to keep automation suite trustworthy.

  

**What We're Looking For**
==========================


**Must\-Have Skills**
---------------------


* **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience in QA automation in a product engineering environment.


* Strong proficiency with **Selenium WebDriver** — page object model, explicit waits, cross\-browser testing.


* Solid experience with **Cucumber (BDD)** — writing and maintaining feature files, step definitions, and hooks.


* Hands\-on with **TestNG** — test configuration, data providers, listeners, parallel execution, and reporting.


* Working knowledge of **TDD principles** and integrating tests into agile development workflows.


* Proficiency in at least one programming language — **Java or Python** preferred.


* Experience with **CI/CD integration** and running tests in automated pipelines.


* Strong analytical thinking with an eye for edge cases, boundary conditions, and failure modes.


* Excellent communication skills — ability to clearly articulate test findings to technical and non\-technical audiences.

  

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* **Domain knowledge in Payments** — understanding of payment flows, gateways, settlement, reconciliation, or fraud systems.


* Experience testing **APIs** with tools like Postman, RestAssured, or similar.


* Familiarity with **performance / load testing** tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6\).


* Exposure to **cloud testing environments** (Sauce Labs, BrowserStack, AWS Device Farm).


* Knowledge of **security testing** basics relevant to financial or transactional systems.


* Experience with **mobile automation** (Appium or similar).

title: Software Automation QA Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Automation QA Engineer — Cloud Security Posture Management**

**About the role** Our CSPM platform discovers cloud resources across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI and evaluates them against security controls and compliance benchmarks. You'll own the automation that proves those controls are correct — a control that silently misses a misconfiguration is a customer security risk, not just a bug.

**What you'll do**

* Design and maintain automated tests in Python (Robot Framework) and Playwright for cloud connectors, the evaluation engine, REST APIs, and UI.
* Validate control logic end\-to\-end — provision intentionally misconfigured cloud resources, verify controls evaluate correctly, and investigate false positives/negatives.
* Verify inventory accuracy across accounts, regions, and resource types.
* Test against real cloud API behavior — pagination, eventual consistency, throttling, and insufficient\-permission cases.
* Manage test environments involving Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Cassandra, and Kafka.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / GitLab CI); debug failures and participate in code reviews.
* We use AI and LLM\-assisted tooling for test\-case generation and failure triage; you'll help shape where it's trustworthy and where it isn't.

**Required**

* 2\+ years in Software Automation Testing.
* Strong Python and hands\-on Robot Framework experience.
* Playwright or comparable UI automation experience.
* Testing SaaS applications and REST APIs.
* Working experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI), including its APIs and IAM model.
* Strong debugging skills and attention to detail.
* Bachelors in CS/Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

 **Nice to have**

* Multiple cloud providers; cloud security fundamentals (IAM, network rules, encryption, audit logging).
* CIS Benchmarks or compliance frameworks (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* Terraform, Docker/Kubernetes.
* Basic understanding of AI/ML testing fundamentals
* Testing AI/ML cloud services or data pipelines.

title: QA Analyst II
description:
Job Description:
**Job Purpose**


You are a key member of the Customer Success Engineering (CSE) QA team under Corporate System Organization, responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and stability of customer\-facing and internal web applications.

  

In this role, you will drive end\-to\-end functional testing, contribute to cloud release management in close collaboration with the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, and expand automated test coverage using Playwright. You are expected to operate independently, manage multiple concurrent workstreams, and bring a continuous\-improvement mindset to the team's QA practices.

  

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and business challenges in the financial sector. ICE team members work across departments and traditional boundaries to innovate and respond to industry demand.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end functional testing for cloud\-based applications — covering functional, regression, integration, and smoke testing across all release cycles.
* Collaborate closely with the SRE team to support cloud release management: participate in deployment validation, monitor release pipelines, coordinate smoke tests post\-deployment, and contribute to release readiness sign\-offs.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites using Playwright; continuously expand automation coverage to reduce manual regression effort and accelerate release confidence.
* Translate business requirements and user stories into comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases; maintain test documentation aligned with Agile sprint cadences.
* Identify, log, and triage defects with clear reproducibility steps and root cause analysis; work directly with developers to drive timely resolution.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives as the QA voice; proactively surface risks and quality concerns early in the development cycle.
* Research and evaluate emerging QA trends and tooling; provide recommendations to improve team processes, coverage, and overall quality metrics.
* Work independently across multiple concurrent projects and priorities without requiring close supervision, escalating blockers and communicating status proactively.

 **Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on functional QA experience testing cloud\-based web applications in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Demonstrated experience working with SRE or DevOps teams on cloud release management, deployment validation, and production readiness activities.
* Hands\-on experience with Playwright for UI and end\-to\-end test automation; ability to design and maintain scalable, reusable test frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of modern QA methodologies, including test planning, risk\-based testing, and quality metrics reporting under Agile/Scrum frameworks.
* Experience with API testing (REST/SOAP) using tools such as Postman or similar; solid understanding of JSON and XML data formats.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integration of automated tests into build and deployment workflows (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).
* Strong SQL skills and ability to perform backend data validation against relational databases.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills; proven ability to isolate defects and conduct root cause analysis in complex, distributed systems.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable reports for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced Agile environment.

 **Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Experience testing financial services, e\-commerce, or identity and access management platforms.
* Knowledge of performance or load testing tools (e.g., k6, JMeter).
* Proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript for test scripting and tooling.
* Experience of GenAI testing.
* Demonstrated organizational and project management skills, including experience leading QA efforts for small to mid\-size initiatives.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Manual Testing Execution**

* Conduct comprehensive manual testing of web\-based and desktop\-based applications covering functional, integration, system, and UAT phases.
* Execute exploratory testing to identify edge cases and potential defects.
* Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality remains unaffected by changes.
* Conduct user experience (UX) and usability testing to validate application usability.
* Participate in UAT coordination and sign\-off processes with stakeholders.

**2\. Automation Testing \& Framework Design**

* Design and implement robust automation frameworks according to project structure and best practices.
* Develop, design and execute automated tests using scripts and automation tools (Selenium, UFT, TestNG, etc.) to validate functionality.
* Create and maintain reusable test libraries, utilities, and components to maximize code efficiency.
* Implement data\-driven testing approaches to test multiple scenarios with varied inputs.
* Establish continuous integration (CI) pipelines for automated test execution.
* Maintain and enhance test automation suites to ensure continuous coverage of critical application paths and regression prevention.
* Document test automation architecture, design patterns, and maintenance guidelines.

**3\. Test Planning \& Case Development**

* Create and implement detailed test cases for functional, unit, performance, security, and scalability testing.
* Establish comprehensive test strategies tailored to product characteristics and client requirements.
* Define test scenarios, test data requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and test executions.

**4\. Security Testing \& Vulnerability Assessment**

* Conduct comprehensive security testing to identify vulnerabilities, security flaws, and compliance gaps in applications.
* Perform SQL injection testing, cross\-site scripting (XSS) testing, cross\-site request forgery (CSRF), and authentication/authorization testing.
* Execute load and stress testing to validate application behavior under extreme conditions and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Identify and document security risks, data protection issues, potential exploits, and compliance concerns.
* Validate secure data transmission, encryption protocols, secure session management, and SSL/TLS implementations.
* Test API security, OAuth/JWT authentication mechanisms, role\-based access control (RBAC), and permission enforcement.
* Perform penetration testing and vulnerability assessment to simulate real\-world attacks.
* Coordinate with Development and Security teams to remediate identified security issues and implement secure coding practices.
* Ensure adherence to security standards and regulatory compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI\-DSS, ISO 27001, etc.) as applicable.

**5\. Defect Identification \& Quality Assurance**

* Detect and minimize bugs, errors, technical, security, and functional flaws in applications.
* Establish quantitative trends of types of bugs and their recurring frequency for continuous improvement.
* Outline steps for minimizing defects and preventing recurrence.
* Ensure thorough defect management through proactive follow\-up and feedback with Development Teams.

**6\. Reporting \& Documentation**

* Prepare comprehensive Test Result Reports (TRR) for each tested release.
* Ensure immediate discussion with Technology Team for validation of observations in TRR.
* Maintain detailed testing documentation and execution logs.
* Generate meaningful reports on testing progress, defect metrics, security findings, and quality trends.

**7\. Quality Culture \& Process Adherence**

* Establish and promote culture of 'High Product Quality' and 'Zero Defect' amongst Development and Product Teams.
* Follow defined standard practices and methodologies for testing and defect tracking.
* Suggest new tools and techniques to improve test efficiency, automation coverage, and overall QA strategies.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies including Travel Policy, Information Security (INFOSEC) Policy, and other applicable guidelines.

**Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / MCA or other Technical Graduates with formal course\-work in Software Development, Testing or Quality Assurance
* Certification in Software Testing or Automation Testing
* 3\+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Software Testing profile for Software solutions
* In\-depth knowledge of Software Testing Process and methodologies is a pre\-requisite
* Sound understanding of Functional Testing and .Net platform (especially ASP.Net) is expected
* Hands\-on experience with both manual testing and automation testing frameworks
* Knowledge of Security Testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment, and security risk identification
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10, common web application vulnerabilities, and security best practices
* Keen desire to research and learn emerging testing techniques and ability to incorporate these meaningfully in products
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to identify root causes and structure solutions
* Excellent oral and written communication skills with ability to engage confidently with stakeholders

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* Hands\-on experience on all types of Software Testing methodologies (Black Box, White Box, Grey Box, etc.)
* Specialization in Security and/or Automated Testing
* Hands\-on experience on Selenium/Unified Functional Testing (UFT) or similar automation tools
* Knowledge in Selenium Tools such as Selenium IDE, Selenium RC, Selenium WebDriver, TestNG \& Selenium Grid
* Knowledge of Android / iOS testing tools and mobile app testing methodologies
* Knowledge of Security testing tools and practices
* Exposure to test management tools (HP ALM, Qtest, or equivalent)
* Sound interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across teams

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
